public_boundary.registration: explicit caller-side as_register_provider_v0 only; no installed registry entry

invariants: Fixed v0 format only: 16 kHz, mono f32, 160 samples. The installed ABI, descriptors, registry, defaults and v0 behavior are unchanged.
The C provider is task-local and off by default; OFF leaves it unlinked and unregistered, ON requires explicit registration on one caller registry.
Missing, malformed, nonfinite or out-of-range controls fail explicitly; no missing result qualifies a candidate.
Unsupported execution modes and missing configuration bytes fail before provider state returns to the caller.
Detector/notch state is per session, finite, resettable and released after sustained absence of a peak.
Clean speech, tonal-vowel stress, loop stability and tone artifact results are synthetic/model-free; no real audio, device, model or release qualification is claimed.
Canonical reports and synthetic output digests are exact and reproducible from the pinned fixture.
release_gates: Closed-loop measured loudspeaker/microphone evidence with pinned paths, gain-before-feedback, delay and nonlinear saturation
Held-out real speech/music false-trigger and intelligibility/quality assessment
Maximum stable gain, residual tone, attack/release, clipping, CPU/memory and target-device timing on intended runtime
Provider intake, rights, license, descriptor and public catalog review before any default or installed provider
